remarks: A perfect blend of elegance and convenience awaits you at this luxury condo complex in the heart of Historic South Norwalk. Enjoy the vibrant lifestyle of South Norwalk with top-tier restaurants, shopping, and entertainment just steps away. A prime location with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro-North. Tucked away by the Norwalk River, enjoy strolling along the paths, access to Veterans Park, and views of the Norwalk Harbor. The Maritime, SONO's premier condo residence, has it all. Unit 406 is one of the larger one-bedroom units, offering plenty of space for a kitchen table and chairs, living room, and office, allowing you to be creative in your design. The open floor plan seamlessly transitions from the modern kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances, cherry wood cabinets, granite countertops, and bamboo floors, to the living room, making it ideal for both entertaining and quiet relaxation. The separate bedroom is a cozy retreat with carpeting, two closets, and ample windows. Additional storage is located by the front door as well as a linen closet. This expansive unit boasts 9-foot ceilings, in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking views of the Norwalk River. Your living experience is further enhanced by deluxe amenities, including a fully equipped gym, a stylish lounge with a kitchenette, fireplace, and pool table, a conference room, and secure underground parking. Pet-friendly.
